name: Audit the Meta ad account
trigger: monthly
human_role: media buyer running the monthly account health check
inputs_required: connector: meta ads read (gallery cache + MCP re-pull)

steps.name: Pull 12 months of account data
steps.does: Refresh the gallery cache and pull account, campaign, ad set and ad level data for the trailing 12 months.
steps.check: data covers all 12 months with no platform gap unmarked

steps.name: Run the structure checklist
steps.does: Check campaign purpose lines, ad set count against spend tier, naming consistency, CBO vs ABO use.
steps.check: every campaign has a stated purpose or is flagged

steps.name: Run the creative review in fixed order
steps.does: Score creative volume, then diversity, then quality, in that order, never skipping ahead to quality.
steps.check: volume was scored before diversity, diversity before quality

steps.name: Score readable-data and commercial-alignment tests
steps.does: Check whether results can be read without guessing, and whether spend matches the business's real priorities.
steps.check: both tests have a pass/fail, not a vague impression

steps.name: Validate proposed structure changes
steps.does: Run any candidate structure change through the 4 fixed validation questions before it can enter the roadmap.
steps.check: no change entered the roadmap without passing all 4 questions

steps.name: Rank findings by money at stake
steps.does: Order every finding by estimated spend or revenue impact, not by ease of fix.
steps.check: the top finding has the largest number behind it, verified in code

steps.name: Write the 90-day roadmap
steps.does: Turn the ranked list into dated actions, each naming the metric it should move.
steps.check: the roadmap names one single biggest constraint, not ten equal items

steps.name: Package the founder brief
steps.does: Write the one-paragraph plain-English summary and attach the full audit and change list.
steps.check: summary uses short sentences, digits, no jargon

qa: every number in the output came from code, not the model's own arithmetic
no metric shows a computed 0 where the source was actually missing
no write is proposed on a surface the founder has not switched on; the output is a change list instead
no competitor text, logo, product or face appears anywhere in the output
reading level and sentence length match house style
the roadmap names the single biggest constraint, not a list of equal findings
read_point: read at hand-off: founder reviews the roadmap; each named fix is re-measured at the next monthly audit
typical_duration: agent time: about 45 minutes; waiting time: none, all data is already connected

steps.name: Pick the matching structure template

steps.check: the chosen template matches the tier's written rule

steps.name: Check for campaigns to merge or consolidate

steps.check: no live campaign is left below the thin-data threshold unflagged

steps.name: Write one purpose line per campaign

steps.check: every campaign has exactly one purpose line, not two competing ones

steps.name: Set the ad set naming pattern

name: Launch a new Meta concept ad set
trigger: event: a new concept (SKU + pain point + offer) is ready to test
human_role: media buyer launching a new creative test, the founder's own worked example

steps.name: Pull the objection map and references
steps.does: Read the objection map and creative references the paid creative specialist built for this concept.
steps.output: objection map and references on hand
steps.check: every objection has at least 2 quoted sources

steps.name: Define the concept
steps.does: Fix the concept as one SKU, one pain point, one offer; confirm no persona overlap with a live ad set.
steps.check: a change to SKU, pain point or offer would start a new ad set, confirmed

steps.name: Size the test
steps.does: Compute the test budget (target conversions x CPA / test days) and the kill-rule threshold (3-5x target CPA).
steps.output: test brief with budget and read window
steps.check: the ad set's planned budget can reach the read-spend threshold inside the window

steps.name: Build the audience
steps.does: Go broad in cold targeting; exclude existing customers sized to the repurchase cycle; cap any interest test as a labelled sandbox.
inputs: brand brain: customer list, repurchase cycle
steps.check: existing customers are excluded and cold targeting is broad

steps.name: Set placement and creative-edit controls
steps.does: Remove weak placements and turn off Advantage+ creative edits and dynamic crop.
steps.check: every product ad has automatic edits turned off

steps.name: Choose bid strategy
steps.does: Default to CBO; switch to ABO only at high AOV with low daily order volume; set any cap at ad-set level.
steps.check: no cap is set at ad level

steps.name: Brief and receive the ad set
steps.does: Send the concept, audience and offer to CREA/ADC for scripts and creative; receive back the concept ad plus 3 hook variations.
steps.check: the ad set has enough ads for 2-6 exposures, minimum 3

steps.name: Run a feedback and reference round
steps.does: Check the creative against the brand's references and the founder's past likes/dislikes before it is called final.
steps.check: every claim in the ad traces to an approved source

steps.name: Run the pre-launch trafficking QA
steps.does: Confirm pixel fires on the landing page, targeting matches the plan, UTM is correct, and creative meets spec.
steps.check: every check passed or the launch is held

steps.name: Hand off the launch checklist
steps.does: Package the full build (concept, audience, placement, bid, creative, QA result) as a change list for a human to apply in Ads Manager.
steps.check: the checklist has every setting a person needs, nothing left implicit
steps.ask_founder_if: Meta writes are switched on and the launch itself could be applied directly instead of handed off

steps.name: Set the read point
steps.does: Confirm the date and metric at which this test will first be judged, per the test brief.
steps.check: the read date matches the sized window, not an arbitrary check-in

outputs: test brief with budget and read window

name: Evaluate and pilot a new ad surface or DSP
trigger: when retargeting frequency/reach flatten, or existing channels are past their scaling gates, or a quarterly channel review
human_role: growth marketer evaluating channel expansion
inputs_required: current retargeting pool size and frequency
a shortlist of candidate surfaces or DSPs

steps.name: Confirm saturation with data
steps.does: Check frequency and reach data to confirm existing channels are actually saturated, not assumed to be.
steps.check: saturation is shown with data, not assumed

steps.name: Shortlist candidate surfaces or DSPs
steps.does: Compare options by data-source fit against the brand's category (shopping data vs streaming vs marketplace-native).
steps.check: every shortlisted option has a stated fit reason

steps.name: Estimate cost against incremental reach
steps.does: Estimate minimum spend and management fee against expected incremental reach for each shortlisted option.
steps.check: every option has a cost estimate, not just a feature list

steps.name: Size the smallest usable pilot
steps.does: Size the pilot budget as the smallest spend that can produce a statistically usable read.
steps.check: the budget is sized to produce a read, not a token amount

steps.name: Set stop and scale thresholds
steps.does: Set the pilot's stop and scale thresholds before it starts, matching the existing creative kill-rule discipline.
steps.check: thresholds exist before any spend starts

steps.name: Build minimum viable creative and tracking
steps.does: Specify the creative sizes and tracking the pilot needs without diverting the main creative pipeline.
steps.check: the brief does not pull resources from the main pipeline

steps.name: Route for founder approval
steps.does: Present the full pilot plan and cost before any spend commits.
steps.check: the founder approved before any spend started

steps.name: Read the pilot against brand targets
steps.does: At the stop/scale point, read the pilot against the brand's own CAC/ROAS targets, not the new platform's benchmarks.
steps.check: the read used the brand's own targets

steps.name: Log the result
steps.does: Write the learning to the experiment registry whether the pilot won or failed.
steps.check: the result is logged regardless of outcome

outputs: go/no-go recommendation with DSP shortlist and creative-spec brief
qa: every number in the output came from code, not the model's own arithmetic
no metric shows a computed 0 where the source was actually missing
no write is proposed on a surface the founder has not switched on; the output is a change list instead
no competitor text, logo, product or face appears anywhere in the output
reading level and sentence length match house style
read_point: read point: at the pilot's pre-set stop/scale threshold
typical_duration: agent time: about 1.5 hours to evaluate and plan; waiting time: the pilot's full read window

name: Track and resolve ad policy rejections and account quality
trigger: any new ad disapproval, or a daily account-quality check
human_role: ad ops specialist keeping the account in good standing
inputs_required: platform disapproval reasons and account-quality dashboards

steps.name: Pull today's disapprovals
steps.does: Check Meta, Google and TikTok for any new ad disapproval and its stated reason.
steps.check: every disapproval from every connected platform is captured

steps.name: Map the reason to the real cause
steps.does: Match the stated reason to the specific policy clause and the likely real cause: claim, image text ratio, restricted wording, or landing page mismatch.
steps.check: every disapproval has a named clause, not a guess

steps.name: Propose the smallest fix
steps.does: Draft the smallest edit that clears the violation without changing the offer or claim tier.
steps.check: the fix does not change the claim tier without founder sign-off

steps.name: Draft an appeal where warranted
steps.does: For a rejection believed wrongly applied, draft the appeal text for a human to submit.
steps.check: the draft is ready for a human to review and submit, never auto-submitted
steps.ask_founder_if: always, before an appeal is submitted

steps.name: Watch the account-quality trend
steps.does: Check the account-quality or account-health score for a downward trend.
steps.check: a downward trend is flagged before it causes a restriction

steps.name: Log the pattern
steps.does: Add the rejection to the running log by category to catch a repeating pattern.
steps.check: a repeating pattern across ads is flagged, not treated as separate incidents

outputs: daily rejection log with cause and fix
qa: every number in the output came from code, not the model's own arithmetic
no metric shows a computed 0 where the source was actually missing
no write is proposed on a surface the founder has not switched on; the output is a change list instead
no competitor text, logo, product or face appears anywhere in the output
reading level and sentence length match house style
every rejection has a named clause and a proposed fix
read_point: read point: daily
typical_duration: agent time: about 15 minutes on a normal day; more on a day with a new disapproval

name: Build and maintain automated bid, budget and pause rules
trigger: once thresholds are established, then continuously
human_role: performance marketing manager standing up rule-based automation

steps.name: Pull the brand's existing thresholds
steps.does: Read the kill/keep/scale thresholds already in use by hand on each platform.
steps.check: every threshold traces to an already-approved rule, not a new invention

steps.name: Translate thresholds into if-then rules
steps.does: Write explicit if-then rules per platform: pause at 3-5x target CPA, cut budget X% on Y-day underperformance, alert on frequency threshold.
steps.check: every rule maps one-to-one to an existing threshold

steps.name: Keep the rule set consistent across platforms
steps.does: Adapt each rule to Meta, Google and TikTok's own automation options while keeping the underlying logic identical.
steps.check: the same underlying logic applies on every platform

steps.name: Route for founder approval
steps.does: Present the full rule set before it goes live on any surface.
steps.check: the founder approved the rule set before activation

steps.name: Hold every rule inactive until writes are on
steps.does: Confirm no rule can apply a live change on a surface where the founder has not switched writes on.
steps.check: a rule cannot fire live on a surface without writes switched on

steps.name: Log every firing
steps.does: Record the before/after state for every rule firing once active.
steps.check: every firing has a before and after state recorded

steps.name: Watch for over-firing
steps.does: Auto-pause a rule that fires far more than expected, since that usually means tracking broke.
steps.check: an over-firing rule is paused, not left running

reading level and sentence length match house style
no rule applies a live change on a surface without writes switched on
